description: This file defines a PHP class 'TaxClass' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Task\Catalog'. It contains methods for generating and managing tax class data, including listing tax classes, generating JSON info files for specific tax classes, and clearing those files.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: A controller class for managing tax classes within the Opencart admin panel, providing functionalities to list, export, and delete tax class data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a task list for all tax classes by adding individual tasks for each tax class to a task management system.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Creates a JSON file with detailed info about a specific tax class identified by 'tax_class_id'.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all JSON files related to tax classes in the specified directory.
